articles.title: Big Storms Delay Holiday Travel and the Macy's Parade
articles.summary: Storms across the US delayed flights and pushed the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade to Saturday, November 28.

articles.title: SpaceX Gets the Go-Ahead for Satellites That Power AI in Space
articles.summary: US regulators approved SpaceX's plan for up to a million satellites to run AI data centres in space, a first-of-its-kind decision that has drawn both praise and criticism.

articles.title: New Tariffs Could Make Shopping More Expensive
articles.summary: The Trump administration plans new tariffs on China, the EU and 12 other trading partners, which experts say could cost each American about $400.
